decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel sits close to the core organic cheese offer and had its own page in 2019 while sibling launches were cut, so it appears to meet aspirations and dropping it would bring little benefit.

The spicy cheese line survived the 2019 pruning and was given its own page, and in a growing industry with no evident performance shortfall there is little pressure for problemistic search that would remove it, though a multi-model line could be trimmed.

The mild creamy soft cheese rounded out the new range and was featured on its own page after weaker launches such as the washed-rind soft cheese were dropped, which suggests results at or above aspiration that justify keeping it.
